nary_nodes.label: Spain's World Cup Victory Parade
evidence: Spain's newly crowned World Cup champions were greeted by a million fans as the team arrived for the victory parade in Madrid.

The players, some shirtless, others holding drinks, set off on their procession along the main arteries in the city centre where a sea of fans in red and yellow were waiting, with the destination Cibeles square.
After flying back from the United States to Madrid, the players were received by King Felipe VI and the royal family, and then Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez, before kicking off the parade.
nary_nodes.type_definition: A celebratory procession, typically held after a significant victory or achievement.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No suitable schema.org type was found for a victory parade

nary_nodes.label: Spain vs Argentina World Cup Final
evidence: Spain's 1-0 victory over Argentina in New Jersey on Sunday, secured by a Ferran Torres strike in extra-time, has sparked an outpouring of national pride in the football-mad country, whose only other World Cup triumph came in 2010.
Argentina, despite the presence of all-time great Lionel Messi, failed to create clear chances against Spain’s well-organised and more positive side in the final.
nary_nodes.type_justification: World Cup Final is a type of sports event

nary_nodes.label: King Felipe VI's Speech
evidence: "You have shown your grit, your resilience and your courage, always backed by your technical skill, your control and command of the game, combining head and heart," the king told La Roja’s stars.

nary_nodes.label: Rodri's Statement
evidence: "I’ve always said it, winning with your country is the most beautiful thing there is, above all a World Cup," said Rodri.

nary_nodes.label: Sanchez's Statement
evidence: "It’s two for two," said Sanchez, of Spain’s record in World Cup finals. "Why not dream of a third in 2030, especially with Spain as hosts?"

nary_nodes.label: Spain vs France Semi-Final
evidence: The Spanish press was running out of superlatives to describe its heroes after they overcame favourites France in the semi-finals before downing Argentina.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Semi-Final is a type of sports event
